record.context_brief: Centerpole finiteness for the free group F2
record.original_question: Does the free group F_2 have finite centerpole numbers c_r^0(F_2) for every integer r?

evidence.quote: Much less is known about the centerpole numbers of non-commutative groups, in particular, of the free group F2 with two generators.
Problem 11.4. Has the free group F2 finite centerpole numbers c0r(F2) for all r ∈ N?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $G$ be a group. For a subset $A\subseteq G$ and a point $c\in G$, write $cA^{-1}c=\{ca^{-1}c : a\in A\}$ for the reflection of $A$ through $c$. A subset $A\subseteq G$ is called symmetric with respect to $c$ if $A=cA^{-1}c$. Given $r\in\mathbb{N}$, a subset $C\subseteq G$ is called an $r$-centerpole set if for every coloring $\chi:G\to\{1,\dots,r\}$ there exist $c\in C$ and an infinite monochromatic subset $A\subseteq G$ that is symmetric with respect to $c$. Define the centerpole number
$$c^0_r(G)=\min\{|C| : C\subseteq G \text{ is an } r\text{-centerpole set}\},$$
with the convention $c^0_r(G)=\infty$ if no finite $r$-centerpole set exists.

Let $F_2$ denote the free group on two generators. Determine whether $c^0_r(F_2)$ is finite for every $r\in\mathbb{N}$.
artifact.status_search_result: Centerpole numbers were introduced and studied by Banakh and collaborators, mainly for abelian groups. Searches did not surface a published resolution of the finiteness of $c^0_r(F_2)$ for the non-abelian free group $F_2$; the question appears to remain unresolved, but no definitive recent reference confirming its status was found.

status_evidence.title: Centerpole sets for colorings of Abelian groups
status_evidence.snippet: Banakh–Protasov–Protasova-style work on centerpole sets, focusing on abelian groups.
status_evidence.claim: The centerpole framework is developed primarily for abelian groups, with little known for non-commutative groups such as F_2.

status_evidence.title: Taras Banakh research profile
status_evidence.snippet: List of works by Banakh on combinatorial properties of groups including centerpole sets.
status_evidence.claim: No follow-up paper resolving the finiteness of centerpole numbers for the free group F_2 was located.
